steps.en: Mount it beside your app, dev-only
steps.zh: 挂在应用旁边，仅 dev 生效

steps.en: Adds a floating toolbar, isolated from your styles
steps.zh: 浮出工具条，与你的样式隔离

steps.en: Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+D and draw on the page
steps.zh: Ctrl+Shift+D 开合，直接在页面上画

steps.en: Classifies each stroke into a shape and resolves the elements it touches
steps.zh: 把每一笔归类成形状，并解析它碰到的元素

steps.en: Press C to copy the markdown at your detail level
steps.zh: 按 C 按你选的详细档位复制 markdown

steps.en: Emits selectors, coordinates and layout deltas your agent can apply in one pass
steps.zh: 产出选择器、坐标与布局增量，agent 一遍就能应用

value.en: 'Circle this, strike that, move the card under the heading' reaches the agent as a structured diff, not a paragraph.
value.zh: 「圈住这个、划掉那个、把卡片挪到标题下面」以结构化 diff 抵达 agent，而不是一整段话。
